page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc8a.48xlarge is a dedicated compute instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz.

The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio positions this server as a compute-heavy resource. This design presents a tradeoff: while it offers massive parallel processing capabilities with 192 dedicated cores, it is not configured for memory-intensive workloads or local high-speed storage operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high core density minimizes hypervisor overhead, making it suitable for compute-bound workloads that do not require large memory footprints or local NVMe drives.

Appropriate workloads for this hardware profile include high-performance computing (HPC), batch processing, large-scale scientific simulations, video encoding, and highly parallelized CPU-bound tasks.
